text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Grey rule: no gain. 620 injected transfers of 25% to 40% of the receiving load, over 1 day, starting in even months, all arms at the same number of unexplained alarms on odd months.'
